page_title: ALA 3-1 ELC | Alaves v Elche 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Miguel Ortiz has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Yusi (Alaves) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
90+7' A quickly taken corner by Alaves.
90+5' 3 - 1 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Lucas Boye (Alaves) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom right corner. Good team effort!

90+4' 2 - 1 Andre Silva (Elche) scores a goal after nicely controlling a pass and unleashing a powerful close-range shot into the bottom right corner. The keeper couldn't do anything to stop this wonderful effort.

90+2' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Elche are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Jonny Otto (Alaves) receives a yellow card for infringement.
85' It will be a substitution. Victor Parada (Alaves) is ready to enter the pitch as Toni Martinez walks off.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Leo Petrot is coming onto the pitch as Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Jon Lopez has decided to make a change. Adam Boayar replaces Martim Neto (Elche).

84' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle as Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. It's a free kick to Alaves, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

81' 2 - 0 Goal! Toni Martinez (Alaves) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Inaki Pena had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:0.
79' The referee makes a quick call and awards David Affengruber (Elche) a red card.
77' Andre Silva (Elche) gathers a cross inside the box and strikes the ball. He wastes a great scoring opportunity as his shot only hits the right-hand post.
77' Substitution. Marc Aguado makes his way off the pitch and John Donald (Elche) comes on as his replacement.
76' 1 - 0 Goal! Carlos Vicente (Alaves) puts the ball into the top left corner past the outstretched arm of Inaki Pena.
76' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is going to take the penalty!
75' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Alvaro Nunez (Elche). The referee gives a penalty kick to Alaves!!
74' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Abderrahmane Rebbach trots off the pitch and is replaced by Carles Alena (Alaves).
72' Eduardo Coudet prepares a substitution. Pablo Ibanez is replaced by Ander Guevara (Alaves).
72' It is time for a substitution. Denis Suarez (Alaves) is on for Antonio Blanco.
71' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. Elche get a free kick.
71' Elche work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
69' Rafa Mir goes off the pitch and Andre Silva (Elche) comes on.
69' A pass by Pedro Bigas (Elche) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
66' Martim Neto (Elche) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
65' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Miguel Ortiz who sees an offensive foul. Elche win a free kick.

63' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
62' Victor Chust (Elche) makes a rough challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul. Alaves have a free kick.
61' The Elche players are exchanging some short passes.
56' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
55' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
54' There's an opportunity for Carlos Vicente (Alaves) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
48' Alaves have a corner.

48' Chance! Antonio Blanco (Alaves) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but Inaki Pena is alert and makes a great save to deny him. The ball goes out for a corner. Alaves can continue in their attacking effort.
48' Alaves win a corner.
46' Jon Lopez has made a change at the break. Martim Neto has come on in place of Grady Diangana (Elche).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Miguel Ortiz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Grady Diangana (Elche) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
43' Grady Diangana (Elche) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
41' A cross from Jon Pacheco (Alaves) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
40' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Grady Diangana (Elche) gets booked.
39' Miguel Ortiz shows the yellow card to Antonio Blanco (Alaves) for a heavy challenge.
37' Calebe is being substituted because of an injury. Eduardo Coudet sends Carlos Vicente (Alaves) on the pitch.
34' Alvaro Nunez (Elche) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
34' A free kick is awarded to Elche. Dangerous play by Antonio Blanco (Alaves). Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.
33' The corner from Toni Martinez (Alaves) is cleared away by the defence.
32' Elche control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
30' The referee blows his whistle, Elche are awarded a corner kick.
29' Elche quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
28' Jon Pacheco (Alaves) picks up a yellow card for a foul.

26' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Jonny Otto (Alaves). Miguel Ortiz saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Free kick. Elche will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
25' Alaves get a corner.
22' Alaves earn a corner.
21' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
21' Calebe (Alaves) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball is out of play and Alaves manage to earn a corner.
18' Now Alaves have a corner.
16' Surely that's handball by one of the Elche players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
16' The referee signals a corner kick to Alaves.

15' Jonny Otto (Alaves) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the roof of the net, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save. Alaves have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
15' Alaves take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
14' Wonderful movement by Alaves. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
13' Rafa Mir (Elche) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Antonio Sivera is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
10' The Elche players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
6' It will be a corner kick for Elche.
4' The referee points to the corner flag and Alaves will take a corner.
2' Elche seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
Elche will kick the game off.
Miguel Ortiz is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
